summary: Independent masked audit of all 16 answers across four consumed selected development cases; packet SHA256 verified. No clear incorrect core applicability decision or unnecessary withholding is established by the selected evidence. Four answers have clear M03/O18 reason-code errors; case-05 A2 additionally overstates non-registration and case-05 A4 has reason-code ambiguity. The six-query catalog is appropriately labeled a design proposal, with future version-composition controls to specify. Experimental defects are retained outcomes, not blockers. No executable checks or paid calls were run.

findings.evidence: catalog-proposal.json composition_proposal links "rows[].order.id" to "order_id" and "rows[].machine.id" to "machine_id", while version_binding is "snapshot/source_sha256/as_of; compare tool also binds each nested version". Type compatibility alone does not prevent composing identically named IDs across different snapshots.
findings.recommendation: Before executing the future composition experiment, freeze same-snapshot/as-of binding rules or explicit cross-version joins and define per-answer scoring denominators. Preserve planned common-information and aggregate budget controls; this is future implementation specification work, not a blocker to publishing the clearly labeled proposal.
